about: nuget.org, the public .NET package gallery. This CLI searches packages, reads package and version metadata, licenses, owner profiles, and download statistics, and lists NuGet client tool downloads, all without logging in.

commands.summary: Search the NuGet gallery by keyword or tag (q=Tags:"bson"), with sort, framework, package-type and prerelease filters, 20 results per page

params.name: q
params.description: Search text. Supports field syntax such as Tags:"bson", id:Newtonsoft, owner:jamesnk

params.name: sortby
params.description: Sort order. 'relevance' is the default ranking

params.name: frameworks
params.description: Comma-separated framework generations to filter by, e.g. net, netcoreapp, netstandard, netframework

params.name: tfms
params.description: Comma-separated specific target framework monikers, e.g. net8.0,netstandard2.0

params.name: frameworkFilterMode
params.description: Whether packages must match ALL or ANY of the selected frameworks

params.name: includeComputedFrameworks
params.description: Also match frameworks that are computed as compatible, not only frameworks targeted explicitly

params.name: packagetype
params.description: Restrict results to one package type

commands.summary: Search packages through the OData v2 API, which returns structured metadata (id, version, downloads, description) with offset paging

params.name: query
params.description: Search term, placed inside single quotes in the OData URL

params.name: skip
params.description: Number of results to skip, for paging

commands.summary: Get the gallery page for the latest version of a package: title, version, target frameworks, install command and README text
Get metadata for one package version through the OData v2 API: dependencies, downloads, hash, size, dates, project URL
List all versions of a package with their per-version download counts and publish dates (OData v2 FindPackagesById)

params.name: id
params.description: Package id, placed inside single quotes in the OData URL

params.name: skip
params.description: Number of versions to skip, for paging (the server returns at most 100 per page)

commands.summary: Get the Atom feed of a package's versions, newest first, with update times and links
Get the license text of a specific package version
Get download counts for a package, broken down by version, client name or client version

params.name: groupby
params.description: Dimension to group download counts by

commands.summary: Get download counts for one package version, broken down by client name or client version

params.name: groupby
params.description: Dimension to group download counts by

commands.summary: Get gallery-wide totals: total downloads, unique packages, total package versions, last update time
Get the statistics overview: top 10 packages, top 10 package versions, and NuGet client usage over the last 6 weeks
List the top 100 most downloaded packages over the last 6 weeks (all packages, followed by community-only rows)
List the most downloaded package versions over the last 6 weeks
Get a NuGet user or organization profile: package count, total downloads, and the packages they own
List downloadable NuGet client tools (nuget.exe, VS VSIX, and others) with their versions, URLs and release dates
